attchmntText: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The Board also approved an unconditional and irrevocable Corporate Guarantee of Rs. 375 crore in favour of Export-Import Bank of India for a term loan facility to Kinet Railway Solutions Private Limited. For the half year ended 30th September, 2026, the company reported a Net Profit after tax of Rs. 370.28 crore, compared to Rs. 323.96 crore in the corresponding previous period. Revenue from operations stood at Rs. 8,966.08 crore. The Board Meeting was held on 12th November, 2026. The statutory auditors, Gandhi Minocha & Co., issued a limited review report noting an emphasis of matter regarding receivables from Krishnapatnam Railway Company Limited. The company also announced the deregistration of its wholly owned subsidiary, RVNL Infra South Africa, with effect from 30 June, 2026.

attchmntText: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited invites investors to a conference call on Tuesday, 17th November, 2026, at 04:00 P.M. IST. The management will discuss financial results and operations for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The transcript, audio, or video link will be hosted on the company website and filed with the exchanges.
